item: BnF Departement des Manuscrits, Francais 2751, item 45 (finding aid ark cc49202m): "Lettre du sieur DE DIOU a monsieur le duc de Maienne, lieutenant general de la couronne et Estat de France, escripte en chiffre. Dechiffrement de cette lettre." Item 46 (folio 120, a different letter, King Henri IV to Cardinal de Bourbon, 5 May 1592) is NOT part of this item.

canvases.note: Connection reset by peer on both the initial fetch and the one permitted retry (brief's Gallica-reset rule); stopped per brief, not fetched. Most likely holds the actual chiffre (encrypted) text: 116v opens mid-narrative in plain decipherment prose, and the catalogue entry names one item spanning 116-119 with both a ciphertext and its decipherment bound together.

canvases.content: decipherment, continuous prose; period foliation '117' visible top right
decipherment, continuous prose; fetched on the one permitted retry (first attempt reset)
end of decipherment, dateline 'De Rome Le 5 Avril 1592', signed 'de Diou', 'Seellee d'un cachet'; fetched on the one permitted retry (first attempt returned an HTTP 500 error page)

canvases.note: blank, only pencil offset/bleed-through of 119r visible; not part of the letter text; not committed

different item (finding aid item 46): 'Copie de la lettre du Roy escrite a Monsieur Cardinal de Bourbon du 5 May 1592'. Confirms the De Diou item (45) is confined to ff.116-119, not 116-120 as the QUEUE row's WebSearch-derived folio range said. Not committed, not relevant to this target.
